_meta.name: Tamkinly content topics registry
_meta.founder_condition: سجلّ المواضيع في ملف في الجيت: لا نعيد العمل على مواضيع منجزة، ونغطي جميع مواضيع الموقع مع إعادة استهدافها من زوايا عديدة
rules: NEVER start content work without checking this registry — one angle per format per topic.
Every angle carries a unique angle_id and status: todo | researching | writing | review | published | blocked.
An angle is ONLY marked published after it has a published_url and a date — that freezes it (no rework on published angles).
Every site topic must eventually have >= 2 angles (default seeds: A1 seo-article, A2 social-kit). Add more angles freely with new angle_ids.
New topics discovered by C1 are APPENDED here (never written ad-hoc) with a new topic id.
C2 evidence files reference topic id + angle id. C3/C4 outputs reference both. The calendar (Hermes) schedules only angles with status >= writing.
Cluster coverage is reviewed weekly: clusters with zero published angles get priority in the calendar.
